recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12465 unless a future work-group decision changes the current multiple-profile semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12465 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ElementDefinition change request raised for DSTU2. It requested changing typeRef.profile and typeRef.targetProfile to 0..* and adding an invariant that typeRef.code must be unique so multiple reference target constraints can be expressed as alternatives without repeating the same type code.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 292398314311cb4026b7620e7b6d7ce00a3c356a, whose subject explicitly names #12465 and whose git-svn-id is build@13068, matching the Jira application comment. Comparing that commit with its parent shows ElementDefinition.type.profile and ElementDefinition.type.targetProfile changed from 0..1 to 0..*, and the ElementDefinition unique-by-code invariant was added.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml is current build-scope source. Later FHIR-44761 added warning-level distinctness checks for duplicate profile and targetProfile values; that later clarification complements FHIR-12465 and does not reverse the 0..* alternative-profile model. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The authoritative current source already implements the requested profile and targetProfile cardinalities and unique type-code invariant.
